acceptance_criteria.criterion: Plan folders with outdated date prefixes are renamed to today’s date before lock acquisition on fresh runs.
Plan folders with current date prefixes, no date prefix, or on --resume runs are not renamed.
If the target folder (today’s date + suffix) already exists, the rename is skipped and the original folder is used.
If Path.rename() raises OSError, a warning is logged and the original path is returned unchanged.
All downstream path state (plan_path, plan_dir, lock path) uses the post-rename path.

_plan_hash and _run_status_path are not recomputed after a folder rename; they retain the values derived from the pre-rename path, matching the filename TypeScript’s runStatusFilename() computed before spawning the orchestrator process.
Constraint §27 documents the pre-run rename behaviour including the _plan_hash stability rule.
All existing tests continue to pass; 8 new tests cover the rename function and _plan_hash stability.
orchestrator/changelog.md is updated with entries for all changes in this plan.
